body:
section .text
global _start
_start:
    mov rax, 60
    xor rdi, rdi
    syscall

section .data
    msg db "Hello, world", 10
    len equ $ - msg
section .text
global _start
_start:
    mov rax, 1
    mov rdi, 1
    mov rsi, msg
    mov rdx, len
    syscall
    mov rax, 60
    xor rdi, rdi
    syscall

add_two:
    mov rax, rdi
    add rax, rsi
    ret

strlen_custom:
    xor rax, rax
.loop:
    cmp byte [rdi + rax], 0
    je .done
    inc rax
    jmp .loop
.done:
    ret

swap:
    mov eax, [rdi]
    mov ecx, [rsi]
    mov [rdi], ecx
    mov [rsi], eax
    ret

factorial:
    mov rax, 1
.loop:
    cmp rdi, 1
    jle .done
    imul rax, rdi
    dec rdi
    jmp .loop
.done:
    ret

fib:
    xor rax, rax
    mov rcx, 1
.loop:
    test rdi, rdi
    jz .done
    mov rdx, rax
    add rdx, rcx
    mov rax, rcx
    mov rcx, rdx
    dec rdi
    jmp .loop
.done:
    ret

gcd:
.loop:
    test rsi, rsi
    jz .done
    xor rdx, rdx
    mov rax, rdi
    div rsi
    mov rdi, rsi
    mov rsi, rdx
    jmp .loop
.done:
    mov rax, rdi
    ret

my_memcpy:
    mov rcx, rdx
    rep movsb
    ret

sum_array:
    xor eax, eax
    xor ecx, ecx
.loop:
    cmp rcx, rsi
    jge .done
    add eax, [rdi + rcx * 4]
    inc rcx
    jmp .loop
.done:
    ret

max2:
    mov rax, rdi
    cmp rdi, rsi
    cmovl rax, rsi
    ret

is_even:
    mov rax, rdi
    and rax, 1
    xor rax, 1
    ret
